# README media

## Website diagrams

`agent-loop.svg` and `simulation-environment.svg` preserve the inline SVG
geometry, labels, colors, and embedded Manrope styling from the public MapleBench
website as captured on September 14, 2026. They are stored locally so the README
does not depend on mutable remote image URLs. The diagrams contain no game assets.

## Header artwork

`maplebench-readme-banner.png` is original AI-generated artwork created for this
repository on September 14, 2026 with OpenAI's built-in image-generation tool.
It uses the repository's original MapleBench website illustrations as visual
references; it was not extracted from MapleStory or WZ data.

Prompt:

> **Use case:** stylized-concept
> **Asset type:** wide GitHub README banner for MapleBench
> **Primary request:** create a cute, polished, original pixel-art banner that
> visually matches the current MapleBench website: an expansive cheerful classic
> fantasy game landscape with bright blue sky, soft clouds, rolling green hills,
> flowers, leafy trees, small mushroom cottages, and a tiny friendly orange
> mushroom creature plus a tiny green slime creature near the lower foreground.
> **Input images:** Image 1 is the existing MapleBench world-background style and
> palette reference; Image 2 is the existing MapleBench companion character style
> reference.
> **Style/medium:** crisp high-quality 16-bit-inspired pixel art, whimsical MMORPG
> research-project mood, original artwork rather than copied game assets.
> **Composition/framing:** extremely wide panoramic header composition, roughly
> 3:1; scenery frames the edges, generous calm blue-sky negative space across the
> upper-middle for a clean repository title area, companions small enough not to
> dominate.
> **Lighting/mood:** sunny, welcoming, curious, adventurous.
> **Color palette:** sky blue, leaf green, cream, warm orange, tiny red maple
> accents.
> **Constraints:** no words, no letters, no logos, no UI, no watermark; keep all
> important subjects away from extreme crop edges; readable at repository-banner
> size.
